encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: οἷον ἀγοράζειν πάντα, μηδὲ ἓν δ’ ἔχειν,
εἰ μὴ κικίννους ἀξίους λίτραιν δυοῖν.

div.note: Pollux 9, 81 τῶν κωμῳδῶν τινες τῆς λίτρας μνημονεύουσιν . . . οὐ γὰρ οἱ Δωριεῖς μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ τῶν Ἀττικῶν τινες, ὡς Δίφιλος ἐν Σικελικῷ κτλ. Photius λίτρα ἦν μὲν καὶ νόμισμά τι, ὡς Δίφιλος. Poll. 9,80 δύνασθαι δὲ τὴν λίτραν ὀβολὸν Αἰγιναῖον.

οἷον significare videtur veluti: nam indicia πτωχαλαζονείας describi consentaneum est. cincinni quam inepte commemorentur vix est quod moneam, quamquam Kuhnius de comis emptis (in foro scilicet) conferri iubet Martial. 12, 23, ut taceam de Hemsterhusio. nimirum scribendum est εἰ μὴ κορακίνους κτλ. de sententia cf. Timocl. 11, 5 sq. et de coracinis, piscibus contemptissimis, Pherecr. 56. Amphid. 22.
